title: +1 Visible Ores
description: This resource pack adds visible ores, but better! Not many ores are supported, but more coming soon! (Also hides annoying glow Lichen!)
body:
Make your life easier with this resource pack that highlights ores like any other ore highlighting resource pack, but makes the ores more noticable than any other ones!![Supported Ores look like this:](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1f33b8014d856b0df22c8caaec0e121e841d35bd.png)
It also makes it harder to see glow lichen so you'll never be catfished by some again!
Supported ores are:
- Ancient Debris
- Diamond Ore
- Deepslate Diamond Ore
- Deepslate Emerald ore
- Emerald Ore
- Glow Lichen
More soon with newer updates!
